newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's prelim Apr ind output up 9.8 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's prelim Apr ind output up 9.8 pct m/m.

text.p: Hungary's industrial output rose 9.8 percent in April compared with a 8.6 percent drop in March, according to preliminary figures, published by the Central Statistical Office (KSH) on Tuesday.
HUNGARY INDUSTRY OUTPUT Apr 1997 March 1997 April 1996

NOTE - April 1997 figures are preliminary. The KSH said it would finalise the figures on June 11. It added that according to the preliminary figures, Hungary's industrial output rose 7.2 percent in the January-April period from the same period of 1996.
